description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for accessing and managing Android hardware sensors in native code, including sensor types, events, and sensor manager functions.

classes.name: ASensorVector
classes.description: Represents a 3D vector for sensor data, with multiple access formats.

classes.name: AUncalibratedEvent
classes.description: Represents uncalibrated sensor data including bias.

classes.name: ALimitedAxesImuEvent
classes.description: Represents IMU data with limited axes support.

classes.name: ALimitedAxesImuUncalibratedEvent
classes.description: Represents uncalibrated IMU data with limited axes support.

classes.name: ASensorEvent
classes.description: Main structure for sensor event data, including various sensor types.

classes.name: ASensorManager
classes.description: Opaque type for managing sensors and event queues.

classes.name: ASensorEventQueue
classes.description: Opaque type for sensor event queues.

classes.name: ASensor
classes.description: Opaque type representing a hardware sensor with properties and capabilities.

methods.name: ASensorManager_getInstance
methods.description: Deprecated. Gets the singleton sensor manager instance.

methods.name: ASensorManager_getInstanceForPackage
methods.description: Gets the sensor manager instance for a specific package.

methods.name: ASensorManager_getSensorList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: ASensorManager_getDefaultSensor
methods.description: Gets the default sensor for a given type.

methods.name: ASensorManager_getDefaultSensorEx
methods.description: Gets the default sensor for a given type with wake-up property.

methods.name: ASensorManager_createEventQueue
methods.description: Creates a sensor event queue associated with a looper.

methods.name: ASensorManager_destroyEventQueue
methods.description: Destroys a sensor event queue.

methods.name: ASensorManager_createSharedMemoryDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct channel based on shared memory.

methods.name: ASensorManager_createHardwareBufferDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct channel based on AHardwareBuffer.

methods.name: ASensorManager_destroyDirectChannel
methods.description: Destroys a direct channel.

methods.name: ASensorManager_configureDirectReport
methods.description: Configures sensor direct report on a channel.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_registerSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor with specific sampling and batching parameters.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_enableSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor at default rate.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_disableSensor
methods.description: Disables a sensor.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_setEventRate
methods.description: Sets the event delivery rate for a sensor.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_hasEvents
methods.description: Checks if there are pending events.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves pending sensor events.

methods.name: ASensorEventQueue_requestAdditionalInfoEvents
methods.description: Requests additional info events to be delivered.

methods.name: ASensor_getName
methods.description: Returns the sensor's name.

methods.name: ASensor_getVendor
methods.description: Returns the sensor's vendor name.

methods.name: ASensor_getType
methods.description: Returns the sensor's type.

methods.name: ASensor_getResolution
methods.description: Returns the sensor's resolution.

methods.name: ASensor_getMinDelay
methods.description: Returns the minimum delay between sensor events.

methods.name: ASensor_getFifoMaxEventCount
methods.description: Returns the max batch size for the sensor.

methods.name: ASensor_getFifoReservedEventCount
methods.description: Returns the FIFO reserved size.

methods.name: ASensor_getStringType
methods.description: Returns the sensor's string type.

methods.name: ASensor_getReportingMode
methods.description: Returns the sensor's reporting mode.

methods.name: ASensor_isWakeUpSensor
methods.description: Checks if the sensor is a wake-up sensor.

methods.name: ASensor_isDirectChannelTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if sensor supports a specific direct channel type.

methods.name: ASensor_getHighestDirectReportRateLevel
methods.description: Gets the highest direct report rate supported.

methods.name: ASensor_getHandle
methods.description: Returns the sensor's handle.
